name: Metaheuristic-Flower_Pollination_Algorithm
description: Flower Pollination Algorithm to Minimize Functions with Continuous Variables

paragraphs: Flower Pollination Algorithmn to Minimize Functions with Continuous Variables. The function returns: 1) An array containing the used value(s) for the target function and the output of the target function f(x). For example, if the function f(x1, x2) is used, then the array would be [x1, x2, f(x1, x2)].
features: flowers = The population size. The Default Value is 3.
p = Chance to create a global solution. The Default Value is 0.8.
gamma = Global solution parameter. The Default Value is 0.5.
lamb = Global solution parameter. The Default Value is 1.4.
minvalues = The minimum value that the variable(s) from a list can have. The default value is -5.
